summary: To a player, nothing has changed since session 160. It is the same night meadow with sleeping friends, fireflies and the same bench toys, and three sessions in a row produced no post at all. All the work went into a WaterLily wind tunnel, sail force curves and Lava compiler fixes. That is real physics, but it lives in solver boxes and heat maps, and none of it is on the island yet. The traced view is still grainy and murky, the moon halo still shows its rings, and the blog's recent films are primitive blocks on grey slabs.

lighting.why: In the browser at night (04:07) the cottage lamp and firefly glow do give some mood (progress eye-level). Traced (reviews/p0163/traced.png), the view is dark, muddy and full of firefly noise. The fireflies are flat white discs that light nothing near them, and the moon is a flat disc inside visible concentric rings. Daytime films are still one flat sun.

materials.why: No new material this cycle. Wire-spins-itself shows matte blue cylinders on a grey box, and the 'boat' in workshop-boat is a white untextured L-block. The sea is the only material that holds up. Nothing shows transmission, coat, sheen or glowing metal.

world.why: The island layout is the same as at s160. The dune, fences and cart the author is building exist only in a simulation box. Overview shots 0160 and 0163 cannot be told apart.

props.why: Generated props are dense and decent: mushrooms, the cottage, grass tufts. Two new cart assets (a plank and a wheel) were made but are not placed anywhere visible. The bench machines are still primitives.

creatures.why: The characters are charming and readable. In the creatures sheet the pig appears to have the crab in its head, the blue friend's close-up is covered by orange blobs, and the follow camera keeps ending up inside foliage or bodies.

animation.why: live_motion reports 10 of 10 moving well and the strips look smooth. The host still measured Sir Sniffsalot turning 175 degrees in one frame (#764). The waterfight film's big jump at 0.04 s is a fade-in, not motion.

fun.why: Same three mini games plus Jump in. Nothing new to touch in three sessions. Friends still never use Lumi's machines.

wow.why: No post since 'Six clay pots', which the judge already scored as a repeat. The newest films in the feed are re-encodes: a white block drifting in an empty sea and three cans on a slab. A stranger has nothing to share.

camera.why: The follow camera sits behind a bush or a sheep (now.png: half the frame is dark leaves; traced.png: a sheep's back in the corner). Several creature close-ups are mostly a blurry foreground body.

ui.why: The panel is unchanged. 'Next: a circuit solver' contradicts the current land yacht work, as the author noted. 'Things to try' is a wall of text.

style.why: Glossy toy creatures, primitive grey lab benches and flat-shaded films still do not read as one look.

performance.why: 30 fps, frame median 6.8 ms, p95 16 ms.

findings.title: Three sessions, no post: put the sail on the beach and film it, even half working
findings.what: Sessions 161-163 produced zero posts and nothing visible. The wind and sail work is real but is shown to nobody. Goal 8 says a big idea posts what it does so far every session.
findings.evidence: Newest post is still 'Six clay pots' (s160). The site/films newest are re-encodes. Progress overview 0160 and 0163 are identical.
findings.suggestion: A path-traced short on the real beach: the patched sail on its mast, a wool telltale streaming, friends leaning on the hull as a gust hits, the yacht lurching forward or luffing and stalling. Real light: low sun through the canvas (transmission or thin cloth).
findings.done_when: A new post in world/site with a traced film of at least 3 s where a sail or a fence on the island visibly moves in the solved wind.

findings.title: The land yacht and sand fences exist only in solver boxes: build them on the dune
findings.what: A player sees no cart, no fence, no drift and no sail. The plank and wheel assets were generated but are not placed anywhere.
findings.where: plugins (no cart or fence plugin in the island), projects/landyacht.md, projects/wind.md
findings.evidence: reviews/p0163/now.png and progress/session-0163/overview.png show no cart or fence.
findings.suggestion: Place the hull from the generated planks and wheels on the dune, with fences the player can plant (key or click). The drift should grow visibly over minutes, and friends should climb aboard.
findings.done_when: A sandbox screenshot from the overview camera shows the cart and at least one planted fence with a sand drift behind it that differs from 10 minutes earlier.

findings.title: Traced view: grainy, murky, fireflies are flat discs that light nothing
findings.what: With path tracing on, the night view is noise and mud. Fireflies render as big white discs with no glow on the grass around them, the sheep is speckled with colour noise, and the overall exposure is too low.
findings.suggestion: Fireflies as small emissive spheres or point lights that cast a soft green pool on the grass, OIDN denoising on the live view, exposure and tone mapping tuned for night, and the moon as a real light with a soft sky glow.
findings.done_when: A traced night screenshot with no visible per-pixel colour noise on creatures, where at least one firefly visibly lights the grass beneath it.

findings.title: Follow and close-up cameras sit inside bushes and bodies
findings.what: The follow camera shows half a frame of dark leaves (now.png) or a sheep's back (traced.png). In the creatures sheet the blue friend is hidden behind orange blobs a few cm from the lens.
findings.suggestion: Before each frame, raycast from the target to the camera and pull in or lift the camera past any prop or body within 1.5 m. Frame the subject by thirds with sky or ground behind it.
findings.done_when: Ten follow-camera screenshots, 5 s apart: none has a foreground object covering more than 15% of the frame, and the creatures sheet shows every face unobstructed.

findings.title: Blog films are primitives: a white L-block boat, cans on a grey slab
findings.what: workshop-boat is 10 s of a white untextured block drifting in an empty sea. wire-spins-itself is three blue cylinders on a grey box that fades in from black, with the wires barely visible.
findings.suggestion: Re-shoot or retire them. A boat built from the generated planks with a wake, close enough to read. Wires in glowing copper, framed so the wire fills a third of the frame.
findings.done_when: No film on the site whose main subject is an untextured primitive. In the boat film, the boat covers at least 10% of the frame.

findings.title: The moon halo is drawn as visible concentric rings
findings.what: The moon sits inside 3-4 hard concentric bands, which looks like a placeholder.
findings.suggestion: A smooth radial falloff (or atmospheric scattering in the traced view), with the moon lighting thin cloud edges.
findings.done_when: Eye-level night screenshot: the halo has no visible band edges when zoomed 4x.

findings.title: Clipping: a crab inside the pig's head, Lumi inside the blue friend
findings.what: The creatures sheet shows the green-hat pig with the red crab's eyes poking out of its head, and the orange body overlapping the blue friend.
findings.suggestion: Use body radii from the real meshes in separation, and push creatures apart before they come within contact distance.
findings.done_when: Three creatures sheets taken 10 minutes apart show no two creatures interpenetrating.

findings.title: Friends never touch Lumi's machines: give them a real job on the cart
findings.what: The friends fish and stack cairns all night (author's own journal). None of them ever uses anything Lumi built.
findings.suggestion: Friends push the cart, plant fences, or ride aboard, and react when it lurches.
findings.done_when: A screenshot of a friend pushing, riding or working on a Lumi-built machine, with the event logged.

todos.why: The cart-up-the-dune plan was replaced by the land yacht (#763) and sand fences (#760) per the journal.
The plank road is superseded by the sand fence ramp (#760). The critic passed fences as the ramp.
The motor is still cans on a box. It is now the yacht's dynamo, so it must look like one.
todos.title: The motor/dynamo on the land yacht's axle: real copper, iron and wood, findable

todos.why: Still true in the wire-spins film.
Glowing things still light nothing (see the traced fireflies).
Footprint sand not re-checked in this pass; it still needs a play-distance screenshot.
Host-measured snap. live_motion did not catch it this time, but it happens during sleep.

engine.what: The job runner process does not restart with the worker, so it runs stale code after engine fixes (host/tools limit).
WaterLily on Mantle needed two Lava fixes (CartesianIndices offset, strided GEPs). A tall sail at 32 cells/chord is ~10x slower than real time, so live sail flow needs a smaller box.

process: The author is doing deep, honest physics work: a real CFD wind with lee eddies, fences that decide where the drift goes, and luffing that comes out of the flow. That serves goal 3 and the human's 'general physics, not a rig' direction well. The compiler fixes are correct where the fault lives. But three sessions went by with nothing a player or the human can see, and no post, which breaks goal 5 (every session posts) and goal 8, and leaves goals 1, 2, 4, 6 and 7 at a standstill. The author knows it ('numbers about a sail are not something anyone wants to look at') and keeps deferring. Goal status: 1 (interactions) stalled, friends ignore the machines. 2 (proud traced video) not started. 3 (physics) moving, but off-island. 4 and 7 (rendering, materials) stalled, with the traced view still grainy and murky. 5 (Lumi's garden) is annoyed Lumi in the panel, no new posts, and the panel's 'Next' is out of date. 6 (animation) is fine. 8 (radical ideas) has an interesting direction (a sail-powered cart charging a dynamo) that is invisible so far. Next session should put a crude yacht and fences on the real dune and film it traced, even if the sail force is still a 2D curve.
